name: Framework Core
description: Deployment-agnostic HELAO framework: base FastAPI/Bokeh server classes, the data-browser/orchestrator base APIs, Pydantic models for Action/Experiment/Sequence/Sample, the micro-orchestrator runners, and the RPC layer in helao/core.

name: Helpers & Utilities
description: Cross-cutting utilities under helao/helpers: config loading, logging, the async HTTP dispatcher, premodels, and YAML/HLO/parquet/zmq helpers shared by every server.

name: Hardware Drivers
description: Instrument backends implementing the HelaoDriver ABC: the core driver contract plus the HTE deployments vendor-specific hardware and data-sync drivers.

name: Action & Visualizer Servers
description: HTE FastAPI action servers that wrap drivers and expose /<key>/<action> endpoints, plus the Bokeh visualizer apps that subscribe to status/data WebSockets and render plots.

name: Orchestration & Launch
description: Orchestrator and operator server apps plus the root launch/orchestration tooling (launch.py, fast/bokeh launchers, append, cli, shell/bat wrappers) that compose and run a server group.

name: Experiment & Sequence Library
description: Importable experiment, sequence, specification, processor, and layout definitions for the HTE deployment that the orchestrator dynamically loads per config.

name: Configuration
description: Station orchestration-group YAMLs, conda environment specs, and tool config files that define server groups and the build/runtime environment.

name: Testing
description: Unit-test runners and standalone test/dry-run scripts under core/tests and the deployment, including the model unit test and per-driver/server test scripts.

name: Documentation
description: Project documentation and licensing: CLAUDE.md, readme, LICENSE, and the runners design note.
